claims.subject: Sprehe Unternehmensgruppe
claims.object: 8 brands and production at 14 German sites
claims.claim: Sprehe states that the group manages eight brands and produces Sprehe products at 14 sites in Germany.
claims.boundary: Brand/site counts do not identify the legal operator, animal origin or product flow for every site and brand.
claims.falsification_condition: A current Sprehe disclosure materially changes the number of brands or production sites.

claims.subject: Josef Wernke GmbH
claims.object: slaughter and cutting operation in Cloppenburg
claims.claim: Sprehe lists Josef Wernke GmbH in Cloppenburg as an EG slaughter and cutting operation within the group's site network.
claims.boundary: This does not identify the origin farm, species volume, shipment or downstream product of a particular slaughter event.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or official facility record changes the entity or site function.

claims.subject: Sprehe frisch
claims.object: contract growers and own controlled operations
claims.claim: Sprehe states that its Sprehe frisch turkey products rely on rearing in contract-grower barns and slaughter in the group's own controlled operations.
claims.boundary: The source does not name the contract growers, identify a specific slaughter plant or trace a particular flock into a product.
claims.falsification_condition: A current Sprehe disclosure materially changes the contract-grower or slaughter model.

claims.subject: Sprehe Gruppe activities
claims.object: Union-Besitz Holding GmbH & Co. KG, Cappeln
claims.claim: Sprehe's current history page states that the group's activities are bundled in Union-Besitz Holding GmbH & Co. KG, based in Cappeln.
claims.boundary: A holding-level relationship does not merge the holding with its subsidiaries or prove identical operating responsibility at every site.
claims.falsification_condition: A current corporate filing or company disclosure materially changes the holding structure.

claims.subject: Sprehe Gruppe
claims.claim: Sprehe's history page records the acquisition of Conow Betriebs GmbH in Conow/Malliß in 2026.
claims.boundary: An acquisition statement does not by itself establish the detailed ownership percentage, asset perimeter or current production role without further corporate records.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company or corporate record materially corrects the acquisition or its status.

claims.subject: Sprehe Gruppe
claims.object: range in 2022 and first organic-chicken slaughter in 2023
claims.claim: Sprehe states that it expanded its range to organic chicken in 2022 and carried out its first slaughter of organic chickens in 2023; its organic page says the chickens come from selected certified farms.
claims.boundary: Organic-product activity does not quantify the share of group production, identify all farms or establish improved animal outcomes across the wider system.
claims.falsification_condition: A current company disclosure materially changes the dates, sourcing model or status of the organic-chicken programme.
